## 1. Plan & write posts
Runs **every day at 08:00** (and when you click *Test workflow*).

1. Gives every new topic in the **Posts** tab a Post ID and a date (every N days - set in the **Settings** tab).
2. A few days before the date, the AI writes the caption, hashtags and creates the image.
3. The row becomes **NEEDS_REVIEW**. A person reads it and sets Status to **APPROVED** (or **REGENERATE**).

**Setup:** open the **Config** node and paste your Google Sheet link and Cloudinary details. Then pick your credentials in the Google Sheets and OpenAI nodes.
